messages:
Jamie (Sales): Hey team — syncing on the PharmaCo POC. They want a 4-week trial, HIPAA-adjacent use cases, and a checklist of security docs we need before kickoff. Can we align on success criteria + what Legal/Sec needs?
Alex (Solutions Eng): Quick Qs: what are their primary success metrics? latency and throughput targets? quality metrics (ROUGE/F1/precision)? also will they send synthetic PHI or real PHI?
Jamie (Sales): They've said anonymized patient summaries for triage automation. Success = >85% recall on flagged urgent cases, avg latency <250ms for single-turn summarization, and no PII leakage in outputs.
Priya (Customer Eng): For evals we should request a 200-sample prompt set with labels and a small held-out test (50). We'll run our eval harness and return pass/fail per metric. Also suggest a small smoke dataset for end-to-end latency checks.
Alex (Solutions Eng): Perfect. For the POC infra: prefer hosted Redwood API to move fast. If they require dedicated, we need a 2-week lead for capacity reservation and pricing commit. Pricing note: hosted POC can be covered by credits up to $5k; dedicated requires committed spend.
Maria (Legal): For HIPAA-adjacent data we need a signed DPA + BAA if they will provide any PHI. Docs we can provide quickly: our SOC2 Type II summary, penetration test summary (redacted), encryption and key management overview. Full SOC2 report and pen-test artifacts require an NDA in some cases.
Sam (Security): Action items from Sec side: 1) We need a network diagram + data flow for the POC. 2) Confirm whether customer-managed keys (Bring Your Own Key) are required. 3) If they ask for a pen-test, we'd schedule a window after staging is provisioned; pen-test results are shared under an NDA. Also need to confirm data retention and deletion policy for POC data.
Jamie (Sales): They asked for data residency in eu-west for GDPR comfort. Can hosted handle that?
Alex (Solutions Eng): Yes, we can route to eu-west region for hosted API. Need to note that routing may slightly bump latency but keeps data in-region. We'll include region routing in config.
Maria (Legal): GDPR checklist: data processing addendum, SCCs if transfers outside EU occur, records of processing, and retention limits. For the POC, keep retention <=30 days by default unless customer requests otherwise.
Priya (Customer Eng): For success criteria doc I'll draft a short template: use case, dataset spec, eval metrics, pass/fail thresholds, test schedule, and rollback/fallback behavior. Can someone review?
Alex (Solutions Eng): I'll review the eval metrics and add the exact commands we run. Example snippet for our eval harness:
```
rerank_eval --model redwood-hosted/gptx --input test_set.jsonl --metrics recall,precision --output results.json
```
Sam (Security): Also add requirement: supply a contact for security issues and SLA for incident response during POC (we usually provide 24h initial response).
DeployBot: Deploy scheduled: staging for pharmaco-poc -> eu-west at 2024-09-10T14:00Z (automated message).
Jamie (Sales): Next steps: Maria to confirm DPA/BAA timing, Sam to send network checklist, Alex/Priya to prepare eval + dataset template, I'll update customer with hosted-vs-dedicated pricing and credit offer.
Maria (Legal): I can turn around a DPA + BAA draft in 2 business days. For SOC2, I'll attach the summary and provide process to request full report under NDA.
Sam (Security): I'll DM Jamie the network/dataflow checklist and pen-test scheduling notes.
Alex (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare the eval harness + a sample 50-record smoke set and post the link here when ready.
Jamie (Sales): Great — aiming to kick off staging in 10 business days. I'll track these items and follow up with a concise checklist to the customer. :thumbsup:
Priya (Customer Eng): I'll also prepare runbook for the POC (how to seed test data, run evals, expected outputs).
Jamie (Sales): Thanks everyone — I'll loop back after the DPA draft.
